title: Anomalous Partial Quotients in the Continued Fraction of $\sqrt{ζ(3)-S_N}$
summary: Let $S_N = \sum_{j=1}^N j^{-3}$ and $R_N = ζ(3) - S_N$. The simple continued fraction of $\sqrt{R_N}$ has partial quotients of generic size $O(N)$. We prove that at the sequence of indices $N_k = (Q_{2k+1}-1)/2$, where $Q_{2k+1}$ are companion Pell numbers, the continued fraction begins \[ \sqrt{R_{N_k}} = \bigl[0;\; M_k-1,\; 1,\; 6M_k^3+12M_k-2,\; 1,\; \ldots\,\bigr], \] with $M_k = P_{2k+1}$ (Pell numbers), and the third partial quotient grows cubically while generic ones are linear.
